clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 6: the cycle 32 nested-frame probe sent by eth_call with code overrides to worldchain-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/public and rpc.zora.energy, 200 of 200 equal to pyevm.py on each.
clearedSpotChecks.note: out/live-journal-480.json and out/live-journal-7777777.json record equal 200, mismatches empty, rpcErrors 0 and the client strings before and after; the files keep only the case count, not the per-case buffers. I ran my own read-only eth_call on both endpoints on 2026-11-27 with three override contracts: the outer frame tstores 7 at slot 1 and sstores 9 at slot 3, a delegatecalled frame overwrites transient and persistent slots 1 and 3 then reverts, and a second delegatecalled frame first runs the reverting frame nested and then writes slot 2 and returns. Both endpoints returned [tload1=7, sload1=0, tload2=0x44, sload2=0x45, sload3=9, tload3=0], the Cancun result, with web3_clientVersion world-chain/v2.8.2-9596311/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and conduit-op-reth/v2.5.1-8f0ccac/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before and after. rpc.zora.energy answers 403 to the default Python urllib User-Agent and accepts a curl User-Agent; this is an endpoint filter, not a client difference.

clearedSpotChecks.check: What in src/ would compute or decide something else if these journals kept a transient credit while the token transfer rolled back: nothing differs on these builds.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The code references hold: CurrencyDelta.applyDelta reads and writes the delta with tload and tstore (src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:28-40), NonzeroDeltaCount increments and decrements a single transient word (src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:18-33), unlock reverts with CurrencyNotSettled when the count is nonzero (src/PoolManager.sol:104-113), and _settle derives the credit from msg.value or the balance difference against the synced reserves before calling _accountDelta (src/PoolManager.sol:349-361). The safety of these depends only on transient and persistent writes being reverted together with the frame, which the lifted runs (0 mismatches in 32905 and 15006 checks) and my live probe show on both builds. One gap remains: the World Chain lift stubbed BalState::storage, so State::storage and storage_by_account_id were not run in the model; the live eth_call probes reach the real database path and agree, so this does not reopen the item.

clearedSpotChecks.note: out/bindiff-v251-vs-8f0ccac.txt lists 983291 differing bytes split as .rodata 961085, .text 20716, .rela.dyn 1408, .bss 62 and build id 20, and out/textdelta.json gives 20099 .text runs with displacement deltas 8 (20091) and 4 (8) and no long runs, which fits RIP-relative references into a .rodata shifted by 8 bytes. The 8 runs with a +4 delta were not disassembled; they are 4-byte words and cannot carry a logic change of more than one displacement each, but which instructions they sit in is unconfirmed. Since the endpoint version string does not separate the two builds, my live probe on rpc.zora.energy is the end-to-end check, and it matched Cancun semantics.
